description: RAG ingestion that stores embeddings with no owner tag, so every tenant's chunks land in one pool that query-time filters can't separate: a Next.js route upserting prebuilt Pinecone records whose metadata has no userId; a sync job upserting an inline notes.map(...) with no workspace/user key; a FastAPI/LangChain endpoint calling vector_store.add_documents() on PDF chunks that carry only loader metadata; a Next.js/LangChain JS route whose splitter.createDocuments() metadata has only the file name before vectorStore.addDocuments(); a Chroma store whose prebuilt metadatas list has no user_id; a Qdrant upsert whose point-builder helper never receives the owner; and a note re-embedder writing every user's notes into one shared Pinecone namespace via index.namespace("notes").upsert(). Plus two writes whose only 'owner-looking' text is not an owner tag: a Qdrant upsert into a shared "customer_docs" collection whose payload is text, filename and source "user_upload", and Pinecone upload records whose metadata has source "user-upload" but no owner key. VC202 must fire on all nine.
